column1: # Malaysia, JAKIM e-solat: the towns of each zone at their own points (the zone round of 13 Nov 2026, ruling R226).
# Every city of the app's list that a zone's list of districts holds (JakimZoneCities.kt) reads every table
# my-jakim.tsv reads for its zone, at the city's own coordinates of the city list: the zone's printed times are the
# times of every town in it, so the engine must not be early at any of them, and how late it is there is the stamp's.
# None is an independent test: the split says `test` because the margins are fitted at the zone's unit in my-jakim.tsv,
# never here, but these are the same tables the unit is fitted on, read at other points. What they give is how LATE the
# app is at each town; that it is never early there is the gate's reading of these rows. A zone's first town is its
# unit's point and is read there. Written by hand from the two files (coordinates and the tables' own paths only,
# never a time); `prove` adds each new capture at these points through official/monitor/recipes.tsv.
